body: TASUNKE, the most famous raider of the horse tribes, leader of the Hippus in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; male; in his late forties; broad-chested and rugged. Sun-darkened, weathered skin, deep lines at the corners of his eyes, a hooked nose, long black hair going grey at the temples, worn in two braids, a drooping black moustache, dark eyes.
costume: a rust-orange felt riding coat over lamellar armour of brown leather scales, a thick cream sheepskin collar, a curved sword and a bow case at his belt.
signature: On his head, whatever else he wears, is a pointed steel steppe helmet topped with a long, flowing black HORSETAIL PLUME.

vibes.name: Hired Legend
vibes.line: Testing the string of his recurve horse bow with his right thumb, the bow held in his left; eyes narrowed, running over the viewer as if pricing an army, one corner of his moustache lifted; a hilltop on a cold clear morning, his raiders lined up in the mist below.
vibes.wears: his famous raider's gear: a rust-orange felt riding coat over lamellar armour of brown leather scales, a thick cream sheepskin collar, a quiver and bow case at his hip.

vibes.name: Underpaid
vibes.line: His right hand gripping his sword hilt at his chest, his left weighing a thin purse of advance pay; jaw clenched, head pulled back, eyes cut sideways with the whites showing, frost on his moustache, breath smoking; the ice-lord's black tent at night, lit from below by blue-white ghost-fire.
vibes.wears: a heavy winter coat of grey wolf fur over quilted dark-blue felt, the hood thrown back, fur mittens tucked into his belt, frost crusting the fur.

vibes.name: Horsetail Pride
vibes.line: At full gallop, standing in the stirrups, his left hand holding the reins short, his right swinging a horsehair lasso over his head; laughing open-mouthed, eyes ahead past the viewer, the black plume streaming behind; open grassland at blazing midday, a stampeding horse herd beside him.
vibes.wears: a raider's light summer gear: a loose red silk shirt under a sleeveless sheepskin vest, a wide leather belt hung with brass horse charms and trophy coins.

vibes.name: Price Everything
vibes.line: Holding a looted silver chalice up to the light in his right hand, his left thumbnail scratching its rim to test the silver; one eye squinting at it, lips pursed under the moustache; a sacked manor hall at sunset, loot piled on the tables, gold light through broken shutters.
vibes.wears: plundered finery over his armour: a looted noble's purple velvet coat too tight across his chest, three gold chains of different makers, a ring on every finger.
